id.description: Stable id used as the keyed list identity.

datetime.description: Machine-readable ISO datetime rendered into `<time datetime>`.

tone.description:
Semantic marker tone. `pending` is a hollow neutral ring for something that has not happened
yet (an upcoming run), the same ring a status dot draws for Waiting.

kind.description:
What the entry is. For `now`, `title` is the pill's text ("Now") and `timestamp` the time at
the right. For `separator`, `title` is the label and `timestamp` and `datetime` say what moment
it marks. Neither draws a marker, a connector, a body or actions. For `band`, `tone` tints the
band (`warning` is amber, anything else neutral) and `title` is its bold text.

groupLabel.description: Optional day/week group label override. The first entry in a group wins.

detail.description: For a `band`: the muted text after the title ("Interborough was off").

expandLabel.description: For a `band`: the text of the button that opens it.

collapseLabel.description: For a `band`: the text of the button that closes it.

expanded.description: For a `band`: whether it starts open. The `onexpandedchange` of the timeline hears each change.

status.description: For a `run`: the status word that leads the row ("Done", "Running", "Failed"), which sets its dot and its tone.

href.description: For a `run`: where the row links to. The whole row is the link.

duration.description: For a `run`: the text at the right of the row, before its chevron ("14 s", "38 s so far").

struck.description: For an `event`: draws the timestamp struck through, for something that will not happen.

plain.description:
For an `event`: draws no marker, so the row starts at the inline start. In the `list` variant
a `warning` tone colours the title instead of the marker ("Missed · Interborough was off").

entries.description: Timeline entries rendered in source order.

variant.description: Rail with connectors, compact rows with none, or a rail whose rows `children` draws whole.

groupBy.description: Optional adjacent UTC day/week grouping mode.

weekStartsOn.description: Week start used for UTC week grouping.

groupHeaderLevel.description: Heading level applied to rendered group headers.

gapThresholdMinutes.description: Hide the following connector when adjacent valid timestamps exceed this gap (in minutes).

label.description: Fallback accessible label used only when aria-label and aria-labelledby are absent.

unsupportedProps.name: actions
unsupportedProps.description:
Optional per-entry controls, drawn at the inline end of the entry's row (a "Skip" button on an
upcoming run). Unlike `marker`, they are interactive and in the tab order. Not drawn for a
`now` or `separator` entry.

unsupportedProps.name: marker
unsupportedProps.description: Decorative per-entry marker content. Must not contain interactive descendants.

unsupportedProps.name: onexpandedchange
unsupportedProps.description: Called when a `band` entry is opened or closed, with the entry and whether it is now open.
